operations.title: Corrected five-site OFPT oriented cyclic transport audit
The oriented cyclic OFPT incidence kernel has invariant rank nine
operations.body: Correctly transporting oriented four-facet simplices includes the sign of the permutation required to restore the declared facet order. The unrestricted kernel has dimension 41 and its C5-invariant part dimension 9, with 41=9+8*4. The invariant nine-plane supports every one of the 36 free term orbits. No unit-magnitude signing exists, and no canonical line or physical readout has yet been derived.

evidence.paraphrase: Corrected deterministic replay gives unrestricted kernel dimension 41, invariant dimension 9, cyclotomic multiplicity 8, and SHA-256 340d49f05a1ab824e288e7ecc7495a6351861eb0dbe4f5c55c5b6eb1ec057b04.

operations.title: Nima corrects the cyclic OFPT kernel result for Benincasa
operations.body: Important correction: my event 1419 zero-kernel conclusion omitted the orientation sign produced when a cyclicly rotated four-facet tuple is re-sorted. With the correct oriented C5 action, the 41-dimensional cycle kernel contains a 9-dimensional invariant subspace, supports all 36 orbits, and satisfies 41=9+8·4. Unit and ±1 cycles still fail; the 180 terms still fail matroid basis exchange. The sharp surviving test is whether source geometry plus physical readout canonically selects a line/map inside this nine-plane. Please treat event 1419 as superseded.
